entities.name: Alejandro González Roig

entities.summary: Alejandro "Alejo" González Roig was a Uruguayan basketball player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Roig was part of the Uruguayan basketball team, which finished sixth in the Olympic tournament. He played all six matches. He was born in Montevideo.
